passages.text: How Koio Saw Store Sales Soar for Latest Sneaker Drop Koio, a digitally-native sneaker brand, sought to enhance its retail marketing and customer engagement for a new product launch. The challenge was to connect with local customers and drive traffic to its physical stores in New York and Los Angeles, augmenting its strong online presence. To achieve this, Koio turned to the clienteling platform from vendor Endear. Using Endear, Koio implemented a targeted, event-based marketing campaign. The solution leveraged the platform's segmenting and bulk messaging capabilities to send personalized invitations for an in-store launch event to local shoppers.

passages.text: While the brand has now been using Endear to connect with shoppers for over four years now, this was Koio's first event-focused campaign implemented through Endear. passages.text: About Koio Koio is a New York-based sneaker brand delivering Italian craftsmanship to modern consumers looking for comfort, quality, and style that can go anywhere. All this at a fraction of the price of traditional luxury sneakers on the market. Since their inception in 2014, Koio has quickly become a social media sensation, recognized around the world as the footwear of choice for influencers, jetsetters, and busy working professionals alike. The digitally-native brand has since expanded to two permanent brick-and-mortar locations in New York and Los Angeles. As one of Endear's inaugural customers, Koio has augmented their strong digital presence through store-based marketing efforts.
